d: Sanjay Jha On Tejashwi Yadav: jediyu ke varishth neta sanjay jha ne tejasvi yadav ke aaropon par palatvar kiya hai. unhonne nitish kumar ke karyakal men bihar men hue vikas karyon ka jikr karte hue tejasvi yadav se saval kiya ki 15 sal ke shasan men unhonne kaun sa pul banvaya tha. sanjay jha ne kaha ki gandhi setu par lagne vale jam se nijat dilane ke lie nitish kumar ne nae pul ki parikalpana ki thi, jo aaj sakar huaa hai. unhonne kaha ki pul ka nirman nitish kumar ke prayason ka parinam hai aur isse uttar aur dakshin bihar ke bich kanektiviti majbut hogi.
